thread:
Alex R: quick heads-up, tokenizer edge-case is triggering 502s for a small subset of eu-west1 traffic. noticed around 22:10 UTC. needs a one-line hotfix and a pin.
Maya Chen: copying logs? stacktrace?
Alex R: pasted below
```
ERROR: tokenizer overflow at model load path=gs://models/llama/3.4.2/weights
Trace: KeyError in token_map
```
Sam O'Neill: deploy-bot health? can we roll to previous version temporarily?
deploy-bot: v3.4.2 serving group eu-west1 reported 4.8% 5xx rate over 5m. Canary policy: 3-step canary. Rollback cmd: `/deploy rollback --service=inference --to=3.4.1 --region=eu-west1`
Priya Kapoor: severity is high for payments flow. I vote pin to 3.4.1 for eu-west1 and expedite approval.
Maya Chen: agree. we should skip full canary for eu-west1 (traffic cut) and do quick smoke then promote. oncall-uk do you approve?
oncall-uk: approving emergency pin + skip-canary small window. i'll monitor metrics.
Alex R: I can run smoke: `/scripts/smoke_inference.sh --region=eu-west1 --model=3.4.1`
Sam O'Neill: :thumbsup: do it. leave traffic at 0.1% for 3m then promote to 10%.
Priya Kapoor: posting change notes for ops: "Pin eu-west1 inference to 3.4.1 due to tokenizer KeyError in 3.4.2. Emergency rollback. Rollback cmd and contact list included."
Maya Chen: quick checklist:
- run rollback cmd (Sam/Alex)
- smoke run (Alex)
- monitor 5xx and latency (oncall)
- update incident tracker (Priya)
Alex R: starting rollback now
deploy-bot: executing rollback... step1 stop new requests -> done
deploy-bot: promote 3.4.1 -> done
Alex R: smoke script: all checks green
oncall-uk: 5xx back to baseline, latency steady. keeping monitoring for 30m.
Priya Kapoor: filing follow-up postmortem stub in #postmortems. tagging eng and runtime.
Maya Chen: thanks team. will schedule a short postmortem + a regression test to catch tokenizer mapping on model onboarding.
Sam O'Neill: Approved quicker approach worked. we should add automated pre-serve token-map validation.
Alex R: noted. closing thread once postmortem link posted. :white_check_mark:
